datasets.name: Landslide inventory maps for Site 1 and Site 2
datasets.source: Authors' own fieldwork and Google Earth interpretation
datasets.verbatim: The landslide inventory maps for Site 1 and Site 2 were created after conducting field surveys and interpreting images using Google Earth.

datasets.name: Landsat 8 OLI data
datasets.verbatim: The NDVI and MNDWI maps were prepared based on Landsat 8 OLI data, with acquisition dates of 2013/09/15 for Site 1 and 2018/04/09 for Site 2.

methods.name: BisDeNet
methods.summary: A lightweight deep learning framework for landslide detection that replaces the context path in the original BiSeNet with DenseNet to improve feature extraction efficiency and reduce model complexity.
methods.verbatim: To address these problems, we propose a new lightweight deep-learning-based framework, BisDeNet, for efficient LD. To improve the efficiency of the proposed BisDeNet, we replaced the context path in the original BiSeNet with DenseNet

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked or referenced, and the custom BisDeNet code is not provided. Other input datasets are not linked or made available.
